import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import math
im=np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0115.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B=im[:,:,0],im[:,:,1],im[:,:,2]
cx,cy,h=2.049,1.508,0.0
hr=math.radians(h); F=(math.sin(hr),math.cos(hr)); Rt=(math.cos(hr),-math.sin(hr))
def bp(u,v,z=0.0):
    D=(1.55-z)*256./(v-256.); L=D*(u-256)/256.
    return round(cx+D*F[0]+L*Rt[0],3), round(cy+D*F[1]+L*Rt[1],3), round(D,3)
slab=(R>215)&(G>215)&(B>205)&(abs(R-G)<8)&((R-B)<20)
tan=(R>170)&(R<225)&((R-B)>50)&(G<R-20)&(G>R-60)
for nm,m in (('slab',slab),('tan',tan)):
    ys,xs=np.nonzero(m)
    print(nm,'n',len(xs),'u',xs.min(),xs.max(),'v',ys.min(),ys.max())
print('--- per col')
for u in range(200,420,10):
    c=np.nonzero(slab[:,u])[0]; d=np.nonzero(tan[:,u])[0]
    s=f'u{u}'
    if len(c): s+=f' slab {c.min()}-{c.max()}'
    if len(d): s+=f' tan {d.min()}-{d.max()} gnd{bp(u,d.max())}'
    print(s)
print('--- raw rows near cabinet bottom')

print('--- floor junction north wall (white wall base)')
wall=(R>240)&(G>240)&(B>240)
for u in range(100,260,20):
    c=np.nonzero(wall[:,u])[0]
    if len(c): print('u',u,'wallbot',c.max(),'perp',round(396.8/(c.max()-256),3))
